name: Azure Database for MySQL
line: Run managed MySQL databases on Azure Flexible Server.

free.text: 750 B1ms hours/month, 32 GB; upgrade within 30 days to continue

cells.regions: Azure regions; availability varies by option

sql.math: $124.83 for compute, plus $3.68 for storage as an example figure. Not included: I/O, backup, transfer, optional resources and tax.
Stopped compute is free, but the pricing for kept backups is conflicting. The total depends on backup use and when the server is stopped.
